proof: Across two hard kills of the real Core, every event (offset, hash, payload), object, checkpoint, protocol state and review view of a finished task reads back identical, the restart adds nothing to that task, the live provider registration is gone with the process (StartTask NO_PROVIDER until the client re-registers it) and its credential is in no file under the profile.
audit: IMPLEMENTED by design (docs/33); proven here. StartTask now refuses an unregistered named endpoint at the boundary.
limitations: The typed Hook Bus is M9; the ephemeral control that resets today is the provider registration, the loop, the broker connection and steering.
